statement: Direction-dependent historical visibility controls the action gain.
evidence: Exclusive swept-sector counts are tiny (0-7 of 108-114 history nodes) and do not separate observed directions in 7/7 runs.
status: HYPOTHESIS_ONLY: no pre-action separation in the collected geometry
counterexample: D79_B_Lplus_2 (L+ executed) has larger L- visible count (98 vs 101) yet the largest observed gain.
confound: Node-level visibility is a geometric proxy, not the Karto matchability of scan structure.
minimal_test: Same initial state, execute both directions, compare realised historic links (requires a counterfactual run pair and is outside this offline review).

statement: The pre-action graph state (arrival graph) explains the gain.
evidence: Arrival graphs differ modestly across runs (nodes 108-114, non-chain edges 8-21, J_T 7.53-9.11); gains do not order with any single arrival statistic (see outcome join).
counterexample: D79_B_Lminus_1 J=8.06 gain 0.0225 vs D79_C_Lplus_1 J=8.22 gain 0.1244 -- close J yet very different gains.
confound: Graph statistics co-vary with place, seed and route leg; n=2 per cell forbids partialling them apart.
minimal_test: Matched-state counterfactual pairs at one place.

statement: A fixed directional advantage (L+) explains the results.
evidence: All observed per-pair L+ - L- differences are positive (B: 0.261-0.339; C: 0.104-0.122); no place shows the opposite sign, so a constant L+ policy is not excluded.
status: OBSERVED (within the sampled protocol): cannot be excluded
confound: Seeds differ between L+ and L- runs at the same place (B 44016 vs 44013; C 44025 vs 44026), so pairing is not a same-state control.
minimal_test: Repeat both directions at a new place with identical seeds; if L+ wins everywhere, the selection problem collapses to a constant policy.

statement: Historic links raise graph information but yield no measurable localisation benefit in this task.
evidence: Corrected target map error changes by <= 0.005 m mean (<= 0.014 m node displacement) across stages; robot boundary localisation change is mixed sign (-0.008 .. +0.063 m); no consistent improvement.
status: OBSERVED: information gain did not translate into localisation gains
counterexample: D79_B_Lminus_2 localisation error worsened by +0.063 m despite a small positive information gain.
confound: Localisation error at these scales is comparable to the TF-lag noise floor (~2-5 cm) of the measurement chain itself.
minimal_test: Longer horizon: track target-map error over many future revisits with the same synchronous instrumentation.
